documents.title: Clarification sought from Advance Agrolife Ltd
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Advance Agrolife Limited reported its highest ever quarterly performance for Q1 FY2027, with revenue nearly doubling year-on-year to reach 3,304 million and EBITDA increasing by 105% to 351 million. The company is actively expanding its technical manufacturing capabilities, including upcoming facilities at Gidani (Unit-4) and Dahej (Unit-5), alongside targeting an increase in export revenue share to 20% by FY29. Management highlighted structural cost advantages from its inland geography in Jaipur and robust growth supported by IPO proceeds and backward integration strategies. Advance Agrolife Limited reported its financial and operational results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting significant revenue and EBITDA growth. The company is actively executing strategic backward integration initiatives, including technical manufacturing capacity expansions for products like Pretilachlor and 2,4-D, and plans to commence operations at its new Unit-4 facility.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its export revenue share from 2% to 20% by FY29.
guidance.quote: We are aggressively targeting an increase in our export revenue share from a negligible 2% today to 20% by FY29.

guidance.claim: AAL aims to commence operations at the new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27.
guidance.quote: AAL aims to commence operations at our new Unit-4 technical manufacturing facility at Gidhani by Q2 FY27, with an estimated first-phase capital expenditure of approximately ¥ 250 million.

demand_outlook.claim: Pretilachlor is a key post-emergence herbicide for paddy, ensuring high capacity utilization across seasons.
demand_outlook.quote: Core Application: Pretilachlor is the premier post-emergence herbicide for Paddy (Rice), India’s largest crop by acreage. Critical for the Kharif & Rabi season, ensuring high capacity utilization.

demand_outlook.claim: Q3 FY26 income increased by 18% year-on-year due to increased demand and new customer additions.
demand_outlook.quote: • AAL’s Q3 FY26 Income at ₹ 1338 million increased by 18% Y-o-Y on the back of increased demand and addition of new customers.
